newsitem.title: UK: EMS/Mark crosses soft but off lows in late Europe.
newsitem.headline: EMS/Mark crosses soft but off lows in late Europe.

text.p: 1440 GMT - Mark mostly lower on European crosses in quiet late trade but off earlier lows amid softer dollar/mark tone.

* Norwegian crown extends gains vs mark, reversing five-month low seen earlier mainly on robust revised 1997 budget which showed growing surplus and upgraded GDP forecast. Monday's jump in oil price also seen providing some crown support. Mark/crown at session low of 4.1390/20 after touching 4.1870 earlier and 4.1670/1700 late Monday.

* Mark/French franc dips below 3.37 francs to near four-week lows. French ruling coalition's lead in latest election opinion polls seen underpinning franc. Mark/franc at 3.3685/87 vs 3.3707/12 Monday.
* Mark/lira trading below 990, currently at 989.29/55 lire vs 991.65/80 late Monday.

* Peseta, escudo firmer, helped by lingering EMU enthusiasm after Monday's EU blessing of Spain, Portugal convergence plans. Peseta also seen firm ahead of Wednesday CPI report and prospect of Spain repo cut as early as this week. Mark/peseta at 84.48/51 vs 84.57/59 Monday. Mark/escudo at 100.58/61 vs 100.74/77 late Monday.
